note: #82: gpt-oss-120b (ggml-org MXFP4, 63.4 GB) on 16 GB VRAM + 32 GB RAM. The file is larger than VRAM + RAM, so it is memory-mapped (--load-mode mmap) and the experts that fit nowhere are read from the SSD. --n-cpu-moe sweep (36 layers). b11476 has no --moe-cache-mib. Quality is not scored here: gpt-oss answers after a reasoning channel, so eval's first-token multiple-choice scoring doesn't apply, and math at a few tok/s would take hours; this run answers whether it loads and how fast.
